findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "tarot" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: astroway_tarot_rider_waite_interpret · Private data: astroway_account_status, astroway_agent_tools · Public sink: astroway_mcp_ai_chat, astroway_tarot_rider_waite_interpret · Destructive: astroway_account_status, astroway_agent_tools, astroway_mcp_multi_agent_coordinate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: astroway_tarot_rider_waite_interpret · Private data: astroway_account_status, astroway_agent_tools · Public sink: astroway_mcp_ai_chat, astroway_tarot_rider_waite_interpret · Destructive: astroway_account_status, astroway_agent_tools, astroway_mcp_multi_agent_coordinate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
